name: Samantha Marocco
bio: Professor and Chair/Program Director of Physical Therapy at Clarkson University's Lewis School of Health Sciences. A board-certified clinical specialist in geriatrics (emeritus), she previously taught in Utica University's post-professional DPT program and served on Clarkson's PT faculty from 2000 to 2006. Her research covers clinical reasoning, clinician wellbeing, and therapeutic exercise for people with memory impairment, and she is completing an APTA Fellowship in Higher Education Leadership.
